headlessGate.falsePositiveGuard: live public names match none of the patterns and stay green — a token (--spring-dock), a component (<DockIconButton>), a subpath (@mkbabb/glass-ui/dock), a prop (v-model:paused). Verified: the swept tree is GREEN while every such name survives in the prose.

piArm.rationale: a prose/comment strip changes no painted pixel — the source text IS the truth, fully captured by the device-free gate. No readPixels/getComputedStyle assertion to drive. The orchestrator may spot-confirm a few re-authored bodies render legibly, but the gate is the binding close.
